title: Length bound for CNF serialization
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over a type of variables, let $w$ assign a natural-number index to each variable, and let $N$ be a natural number. If every variable in every clause of $\varphi$ is mapped to an index less than $N$, then the length of the binary serialization of the relabeled formula is at most $\operatorname{cost}(\varphi)(N+3)+1$, where $\operatorname{cost}(\varphi)$ is the sum, over its clauses $C$, of $|C|+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A map from variables to natural numbers
